Why does your fastest item always run out first?

Picture a typical distributor: a shop orders 20 bags of tur dal, only 12 are left, and the supplier takes 7 days. When reordering is done from memory, fast movers run out while slow movers pile up. This is a typical example, not a real client.

Set a reorder level for every item: average daily sales x lead time in days, plus safety stock. Sell 40 a day, wait 7 days, keep 100 spare, and you order when stock falls to 380. In the trading demo, one tick shows every item below its reorder level.

Try a live demo with sample data at resolveai.cc, no sign-up.
